notes.title: Save Ukraine!
notes.content:
I ask all concerned people of the world to join and support my country in this extremely difficult time for it. My country and my hometown are going through incredibly horrible things. She is attacked by an enemy who knows no pity for anyone. They shoot unarmed men, women and children. No country has experienced such atrocities since World War II.

I beg you to support our people, our men, women and children, and to join the charity campaign for the humanitarian support of refugees and financial assistance to all my compatriots whose cities are on the brink of humanitarian catastrophe. Women and children hide in damp basements while their husbands die defending their homes. As part of the community of game developers in Ukraine, we are also joining the action in support of our country. 

We will donate all the proceeds from the sale of our game to charitable humanitarian organizations to provide the necessary necessities for refugees and people who are currently in cities that are under constant fire. Please do not be indifferent and help as much as you can.

notes.title: Today!
notes.content: [b]Steam players! The time has come for you to appreciate this so different game. We look forward to your feedback and hope that you will receive the most unforgettable emotions.[/b]
